pages.text: Columns of Stabilizer Pylons hold a $(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l)'s crystal steady. They are also the $(l)only way power goes in and out$() of the core, so every core needs them.

Stack pylons into $(l)columns$(). The bottom block gets a footing, the top one a $(l)cradle$() with a landing pad.$(br)$(li)Put the columns on the $(l)same level$() as the pedestal, $(l)in line with it$() on its sides (north, south, east, west), one column per side.$(br)$(li)Each tier needs $(l)as many columns as its number$().
pages.title: Building the columns

pages.text: $(li)Each column must be at least $(l)one block taller$() than the tier, and within the distance in the table, counted from the pedestal.$(br)$(li)Nothing may stand between a column and the crystal at the crystal's height.
When a column links up, its drone lifts off the cradle, flies to the crystal and circles it, rising and falling. It sends the crystal waves that hold it steady.
$(li)With enough linked columns the core is $(l)Online$(): the crystal spins, shines white and breathes, closing as the waves land. Its heart grows as it fills up.
pages.title: Online and Unstable

pages.text: $(li)With too few it is $(l)Unstable$(): the crystal slows down and flickers violet, its breath lurches, and the drones falter, tilt and send violet waves. $(l)Nothing goes in or out$(), but what it already stores is kept.
The core's screen tells you what is wrong with each side: no pylon, too close, too far, too short or beam blocked. Right-click any block of a lined-up column to open it.

Connect cables to $(l)any block$() of a linked column. An $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) plugs into a socket that appears on the pylon's side.$(br)$(li)$(l)To fill the core$(): cables and generators push into any linked pylon, CyberFarm's or any other mod's.
pages.title: Power in and out

pages.text: $(li)$(l)To draw from it$(): the core never pushes power out by itself. $(l)Right-click the arm$() of the Energy Conduit that touches a pylon, so the cable $(l)pulls$() (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)). Other mods' cables that pull work too.
